summary.quick_take: Carrd and Framer both sit in the broader website builder landscape, but they appeal to slightly different buying motions. Carrd leans into recurring lifetime payouts, while Framer leans into mixed payout terms. The better fit depends on whether you want the cleaner affiliate story, the broader positioning angle, or both.
